mapper.update: UPDATE bike_order_reservation r JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=r.order_id JOIN bike_pi p ON p.id=#{piId} AND p.source_order_id=o.id SET r.hold_mode='PAID',r.payment_hold_pi_id=p.id,r.payment_held_at=NOW(3), r.payment_held_by=#{operatorId},r.payment_held_amount=#{paidAmount} WHERE r.order_id=#{orderId} AND r.hold_mode='TIMED' AND r.expires_at>NOW(3) AND o.status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_SHIPPED') AND p.status IN ('CONFIRMED','RELEASED') AND #{paidAmount}>=p.deposit_required_amount
